title: Facilities Managers
description: Plan, direct, or coordinate operations and functionalities of facilities and buildings. May include surrounding grounds or multiple facilities of an organization's campus.

tasks.text: Monitor the facility to ensure that it remains safe, secure, and well-maintained.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Systems data monitored by AI; facilities need human oversight

tasks.text: Oversee the maintenance and repair of machinery, equipment, and electrical and mechanical systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Facility maintenance direction requires hands-on site oversight

dwas.name: Direct facility maintenance or repair activities.

tasks.text: Oversee construction and renovation projects to improve efficiency and to ensure that facilities meet environmental, health, and security standards, and comply with government regulations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Managing construction is site leadership and accountability

tasks.text: Plan, administer, and control budgets for contracts, equipment, and supplies.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Budget drafting from assumptions; human validates assumptions

emerging.task: Plan, create, and manage budgets for contracts, equipment, and supplies.
emerging.original_task: Plan, administer, and control budgets for contracts, equipment, and supplies.

tasks.text: Participate in architectural and engineering planning and design, including space and installation management.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Layout planning aided; human owns design

dwas.name: Plan facility layouts or designs.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Set goals and deadlines for the department.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Goals drafted; leadership accountability human

tasks.text: Conduct classes to teach procedures to staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Program design aided, delivery and engagement are human

tasks.text: Prepare and review operational reports and schedules to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Status/progress reports from tracked data

dwas.name: Prepare operational progress or status reports.

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Inventory management systems; human handles physical counts

dwas.name: Manage inventories of products or organizational resources.
Purchase materials, equipment, or other resources.

tasks.text: Dispose of, or oversee the disposal of, surplus or unclaimed property.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Allocation decisions need human judgment and authority
decision support — Procurement drafting and comparison; human commits funds

dwas.name: Purchase materials, equipment, or other resources.

emerging_tasks.task: Plan, create, and manage budgets for contracts, equipment, and supplies.
emerging_tasks.original_task: Plan, administer, and control budgets for contracts, equipment, and supplies.

emerging_tasks.task: Review and approve payroll for employees.
